'''Finn Jarpane''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Jarpane was skilled at dodging, bargaining, gambling, and use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weaponry. She was also culturally knowledgeable and stood 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. She carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], and a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck, and wore a tunic, pants, [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Finn Jarpane was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Jarpane's character type was listed as "Female Gambler" and her model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
